The climate in Cluj-Napoca

Cluj-Napoca is about 340 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 27°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −4°C. Around 710 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 108 mm).

Best time to visit Cluj-Napoca

The most pleasant weather in Cluj-Napoca is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 22°C and 27°C, with up to 15 days of rain a month. In January nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
